cli-empty-session-foreground.detail: OS foreground and real input selected the CLI file from an empty session; saved bytes match

notebook-edit-save.detail: OS input edited the first cell; native save retained outputs, attachments, metadata and unknown fields

notebook-recovery-written.detail: Unsaved native edits and full outputs reached recovery storage while source stayed saved

notebook-recovery-restored.detail: Restart with no CLI argument restored the unsaved cell; real OS input appended to it and full recovery snapshot matches

notebook-export-copy.detail: Platform Save File dialog produced the recovered copy; all fields preserved, source bytes unchanged and recovery retained

notebook-recovery-save.detail: Native save wrote the restored cell and preserved every fixture field; matching recovery copies were removed

limitations: Windows Server 2022 disposable CI desktop, not physical hardware
Built-in Jupyter reader and 256 KiB output fixture only
No published extension, kernel, independent views, ACL/hard-link validation or power loss
